switch

Switch selector.

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
checked Boolean false No Selected or not.
disabled Boolean false No Disabled or not.
type String switch No Style. The options are as follows: switch and checkbox.
color String #04BE02 No Color of the switch component, which is the same as that of the CCS.
bindchange eventHandle No Whether to trigger the change event when checked changes. The output is event.detail= {value}.

Sample Code


<view>
  <switch bindchange='switchChange' />
</view>

Page({
  switchChange: function(e) {
    console.log(e.detail.value)
  }
})
